eventDetail.scope: ICMIE 2026 focuses on Measurement, Instrumentation and Electronics (MIE), a key engineering discipline covering the design, development and application of advanced measurement, sensing and control systems. The conference scope includes theoretical innovations, technical advances and industrial applications of high-precision, intelligent, integrated and miniaturized instruments in healthcare, aerospace, automotive, telecommunications and other sectors. It provides a global academic platform for presenting latest achievements, discussing emerging trends and addressing technical challenges in measurement science, instrumentation engineering and electronic technologies.
